stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 1 of the excerpt from “What the Octopus Knows.”

On a summer holiday by the sea, I found Octopus and Squid: The Soft Intelligence (1973) in my great-aunt's bookcase.

The most likely reason the author includes this detail about reading the book is to —

options.label: A
options.text: engage the reader by describing a relatable situation

options.label: B
options.text: establish scientific credentials to inform others about octopuses

options.label: C
options.text: introduce scientific evidence from a leading octopus researcher

options.label: D
options.text: reveal to the reader the relevance of an ordinary incident

visual_elements: quotation box with italicized text: On a summer holiday by the sea, I found Octopus and Squid: The Soft Intelligence (1973) in my great-aunt's bookcase.
